limitations: OpenAlex returns broad query matches; each of ten queries reached the first-page limit of50. Do not infer no further relevant papers.
SemanticScholar HTTP429 failures are limited-source attempts, not zero-hit searches. Two successful first pages are capped at50.
No full-text semantic reading performed in this retrieval role. Named abstract pool has25 items; fetched abstracts outside pool are metadata-only.

Duplicate arxiv seed-query execution was started before learning catalog agent already covered all ten directions. Its local outputs are redundant and excluded from these counts; use catalog/retrieval.json as authoritative arxiv record.
